2609.17521.title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
2609.17521.paper_summary: Interactive control for video generation is moving from coarse prompts toward fine-grained, physically meaningful manipulation of dynamic scenes. Yet existing controllable methods either require the full control schedule before generation starts, or use pixel-space signals that dictate object positions rather than physical dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose PhysStream, an autoregressive model for physics-grounded image-to-video synthesis that incorporates structured scene memory---positional maps and object tracking maps derived online from previously generated frames---and supports fine-grained motion control via sparse velocity-increment signals that encode physical quantities, letting the model learn the underlying dynamics. We train our model in two stages: a bidirectional model is first finetuned with motion-control conditioning, then a causal autoregressive model is trained with additional structured scene memory, further improving physical consistency. PhysStream enables interactive, mid-generation control over multi-object tabletop rigid-body scenes---a capability not supported by prior methods---reducing motion distribution distance (FVMD) by 33% and trajectory error by 12% over the strongest baselines on synthetic benchmarks, and is preferred by human evaluators in over 85% of in-the-wild comparisons. Please check our website for more details: https://czzzzh.github.io/PhysStream
2609.17521.paper_summary_zh: 互動控制視頻生成正從粗略提示轉向對動態場景的細緻、物理意義的操控。<lb/>然而，現有的可控方法要麼在生成開始之前需要完整的控制計劃，要麼使用像素空間信號來決定物體位置，而不是物理動態。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了PhysStream，一種基於物理的圖像到視頻合成的自回歸模型，該模型結合了結構化場景記憶——從先前生成的幀在線獲得的位置信息圖和物體跟踪圖——並通過稀疏速度增量信號支持細緻的運動控制，這些信號編碼物理量，讓模型學習潛在的動態。<lb/>我們的模型分兩個階段進行訓練：首先用運動控制條件微調雙向模型，然後用額外的結構化場景記憶訓練因果自回歸模型，進一步提高物理一致性。<lb/>PhysStream使得對多物體桌面剛體場景的互動、生成過程中的控制成為可能——這是先前方法不支持的功能——在合成基準上將運動分佈距離（FVMD）減少了33%，將軌跡誤差減少了12%，並且在超過85%的實地比較中被人類評估者偏好。<lb/>有關更多詳細信息，請查看我們的網站：https://czzzzh.github.io/PhysStream
